target.title: fix: redact colon and folded bearer diagnostics
target.body:
Closes https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/issues/936.

Redacts colon-delimited and line-folded bearer credentials in both the Go CLI and Worker diagnostic redaction paths. The maintained candidate also covers combined colon folds, optional whitespace before the colon, multiple-space separators, and already-redacted placeholders while preserving existing structured credential redaction.

Proof requested by ClawSweeper:

```text
$ go run .
go_header_colon output="Authorization: [redacted]\nendpoint=https://api.example.invalid" leaked=false
go_bearer_fold output="diagnostic Bearer [redacted] from provider" leaked=false

$ node /tmp/crabbox-proof-940/worker/worker-proof.mjs
worker_header_colon output="Authorization: [redacted]\nendpoint=https://worker.example.invalid" leaked=false
worker_bearer_fold output="diagnostic Bearer [redacted] from provider" leaked=false
```

The Go proof is a throwaway module under `/tmp/crabbox-proof-940/go` importing the real `github.com/openclaw/crabbox/internal/cli` helper from this branch. The Worker proof bundles a throwaway script that imports the real `worker/src/http.ts` redaction helper from this branch.

Maintainer verification on exact candidate `715dbf4b7158e3fa4d3ea521c2c346b94cfadc20`:

```text
go test ./internal/cli -run 'TestRedactDiagnosticSecrets' -count=1 -v
PASS

npm test --prefix worker -- http.test.ts
Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests       43 passed (43)

go vet ./...
go test -race ./...
go build -trimpath -o bin/crabbox ./cmd/crabbox
node scripts/build-docs-site.mjs
PASS

npm run format:check --prefix worker
npm run lint --prefix worker
npm run check --prefix worker
npm test --prefix worker
npm run build --prefix worker
830 passed, 2 skipped; PASS

autoreview --mode branch --base origin/main
findings: 0
```

The focused Go and Worker runs execute the production redaction helpers with safe dummy credentials. They assert that ordinary, colon, folded, combined colon-folded, whitespace-before-colon, and multiple-space bearer values are absent while non-secret routing context and existing `[redacted]` placeholders remain visible. This deterministic helper has no external provider or funded resource to provision.
